description: Use this when you need the conversations that contain a keyword, sender, recipient, or subject, instead of each matching message. Read-only; requires auth. Inputs: inbox_id (required; inbox id, username, or email), q (required; every word must match subject, body text, from, or to), limit (optional, default 20, max 50). Returns {object:"list", inbox_id, q, data:[thread]} ordered by the best matching message. Each thread includes folder and purge_after. Omit folder to search inbox and archive only. An empty q returns HTTP 400 missing_query. A bad folder returns invalid_folder. An unknown inbox returns inbox_not_found.

folder.description: inbox, archive, spam, trash, or all. Omit to search inbox and archive only. A bad value returns invalid_folder.

inbox_id.description: Inbox id (inb_…), username, or full email address

q.description: Search words; every word must match subject, body, from, or to

name: cooper_search_threads

data.description: Items on this page, in the order the tool description gives.

assignment.description: Current assignment {assignee, note, claimed_until, claim_active, …}, or null.

attachment_count.description: Number of attachments across the thread.

created_at.description: ISO-8601 time the object was created.

inbox_id.description: Inbox id (inb_…) this object belongs to. Null when it applies to every inbox.

message_count.description: Number of messages on the thread.

purge_after.description: ISO-8601 time a trashed thread is deleted, or null.

received_at.description: ISO-8601 time of the latest inbound message, or null.

recipients.description: Addresses that received mail on this thread.

senders.description: Addresses that sent mail on this thread.

sent_at.description: ISO-8601 time of the latest outbound message, or null.

updated_at.description: ISO-8601 time the object last changed.

inbox_id.description: Inbox id (inb_…) this object belongs to. Null when it applies to every inbox.

object.description: Object type name, such as list, message, or thread.

q.description: The search query that was run.

title: Search threads
